offence: Breach of Article 48.1 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing and in-car video evidence. The FIA transponder indicated a false start. This was confirmed by examination of the video evidence from the on-board camera of Car 44. As the start of Car 44 was only very slightly ahead of the start signal, the minimum penalty is applied.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 44 False Start
to: The Team Manager, Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team
